name: Valley terraces
kicker: Rice terraces on a limestone valley
summary: Give the morning to the terrace walls, with the limestone ridge behind the crop. Stay if that valley is the trip. Go to Mai Chau for Bản Lác, and to Ninh Binh for the boats. Late May to early June is green young rice. September and October are gold. One note calls both windows golden. The fee and the hour are check on arrival.
getThere: From a stilt house at Bản Đôn, the fields are the view.
heroCaption: Terrace walls holding water, with the limestone ridge behind

notice.title: May is the green crop
notice.body: Come in late May for green young rice. September and October are the gold window. One note calls both windows golden.

body: Walk the edges of the terraces in the morning. Late May to early June is green young rice, and September and October are ripe gold. One note calls both of those windows ripe and golden, so a May field is not a gold field on the other accounts. Bamboo water wheels lift stream water onto the fields. They are scattered, and no single wheel has an address.

The fields are the view from a stilt house if you sleep at Bản Đôn, in old Thành Lâm, now inside xã Pù Luông. Bản Hiêu and the hamlets Son, Bá, and Mười sit in xã Cổ Lũng. The hour and the fee are check on arrival.

figures.caption: Two people walking the rice terraces, with the limestone ridge behind
figures.alt: Two people on a path through rice terraces, limestone hills behind them in Pu Luong

gettingThere: The terraces are the valley floor and the lower slopes, especially around Bản Đôn and on the Hiêu side. If you sleep at Bản Đôn, the fields are the view from the house. Bicycles are offered on the valley road, with steeper lanes if you want them. Homestays often lend a bicycle without a charge. That often is one account. The charge is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Bản Đôn
legs.body: On foot from the house. The fields start at the foot of the hill. Check the minutes on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: By road. One distance is about 210 km. Another is about 160 km southwest, with a limousine of about 4.5 hours from Giáp Bát or Mỹ Đình. Check the minutes on arrival. A car or a motorbike hired in Hanoi is the usual road.
